title: The Keeper of Lost Things
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Original 2D layered motion-comic BACKGROUND for Mochi Mayhem, portrait 2:3, 1024x1536-like. Cute confectionery fantasy, softly painted rich pastel color, crisp dark plum outlines, simple readable storybook shapes, glossy candy highlights, emotional and mysterious rather than horror. This is one full opaque environment only, NOT a mockup, not a comic sheet. Camera: gently elevated frontal theatrical staging so separate boss and Ruby puppets can move over it. Keep centre 45% width around middle 35–66% of canvas fairly empty and flat-lit for moving puppets; place narrative props at left/right and upper half. Bottom 28% is quiet dark plum/soft ground reserved for live Ruby narration. No text, no labels, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no border, no UI, no drawn heroes, no drawn monsters, no bosses baked into the image. No extra mouths or eyes on roots/props. Render a complete polished environment, no empty transparency. Scene: Old confectionery palace drainage chamber, copper pipes and carved stone water channels. Along the left wall, tiny forgotten ribbon scraps, pastry moulds, a cracked jam spoon and empty flavor bottles lovingly collected on shelves; water gates at right clogged by dark violet crystals. Small clean golden reflection beyond sluice. Emotional theme: a keeper afraid forgotten memories will wash away.
